newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rig count up 3 to 918 in latest week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rig count up 3 to 918 in latest week.

text.p: The number of rigs exploring for oil and natural gas in the United States stood at 918 as of April 4, up three from the prior week and 193 above the year-ago total of 725, Baker Hughes Inc reported.
The number of rigs drilling on land rose by three to 763, while rigs working offshore rose by one to 127.

The number of rigs active in inland waters dipped by one to 28. Among the individual states, the biggest changes occurred in Louisiana, which was up by 11, Texas, which was down by six, and California, which was down by seven.
The Gulf of Mexico rose by one to 122.
